name: Watcher antenna
description: A feeler the size of the screen, meant to stand just off the corner of the home screen and sweep the air over it. Everything else in the roster wears antennae at body scale; this one is drawn at menu scale, so whatever is carrying it is enormous and off-frame — which is the point on a title screen for a run about being hunted by smell. Silhouette only, and unlit like every antenna in this world, because a glow would mean emission and an antenna only ever receives. The root sits on the document origin, so a scene places it by saying where it comes out of the floor. Its segments carry a joint ring where each sits in the next, a band a shade lighter down the side that faces the camp, and three setae off the outer edge, all dark on dark and placed in the segment's own frame with the segment's tracks, so they turn with it. Detail by scripts/antenna.py over the hand-drawn segments. twitch.description: one snap, a recoil and a settle, travelling root to tip — the ordinary tic, fired on an irregular beat by whoever is playing it

shiver.description: the whole feeler buzzes at once, swelling and dying, the shudder running up its length — saved for after a skipped beat, so it reads as a reaction rather than a habit

flinch.description: snatched away in a single frame and crept back over the rest — for when something touches it
